blocks.text: 三月的窗邊　幸福的香味
blocks.spelling: sann gue̍h ê thang pinn hīng-hok ê phang-bī

blocks.text: 阮躲置有你的情境
blocks.spelling: gún bih tì ū lí ê tsîng-kíng

blocks.text: 離開已經彼多年　攏無你的消息
blocks.spelling: lī-khui í-king hiah-tsuē nî lóng bô lí ê siau-sit

blocks.text: 你咁有找到你的春天
blocks.spelling: lí kam ū tshuē-tio̍h lí ê tshun-thinn

blocks.text: 花開已經過時　不通擱再等你
blocks.spelling: hue-khui í-king kuè-sî m̄-thang koh-tsài tán lí

blocks.text: 阮親像袂開的花蕊
blocks.spelling: gún tshin-tshiūnn buē-khui ê hue-luí

blocks.text: 青春已經褪了色　還沒人來同情
blocks.spelling: tshing-tshun í-king thuè liáu sik iáu bô-lâng lâi tông-tsîng

blocks.text: 若愛你　哪通怨恨你
blocks.spelling: ná ài lí ná thàng uàn-hūn lí

blocks.text: 祝福你　平平安安
blocks.spelling: tsiok-hok lí pîng-pîng-an-an

blocks.text: 事事項項順著你的心　愛你的人惦身邊照顧你
blocks.spelling: sū-sū-hāng-hāng sūn-tio̍h lí ê sim ài lí ê lâng tiām sin-pinn tsiàu-kòo lí

blocks.text: 祝福我　平平靜靜　一人惦在秋雨的窗邊
